text.template.design-dev.title: Design → development
text.template.design-dev.about: Design goes first: versions are made and reviewed, the main one is chosen. The approved design becomes a development issue and goes through implementation and testing. It is the same issue from the first request to the check of the result.
text.template.design-dev.status.Design: a design version is being made
text.template.design-dev.status.Design Review: a version is ready: people compare versions and write notes
text.template.design-dev.role.design: reviews versions, writes notes, chooses the main one
text.template.design-dev.role.lead: decides whether the design goes to development
text.template.design-dev.role.qa: checks the result and closes the issue
text.template.design-dev.type.Task: one issue per element: its design and its development
text.template.design-dev.type.Story: a larger piece of work in parts
text.template.design-dev.rule.done: Done only after Human Testing: AI Testing cannot close an issue.
